design.description: 参考二楼柱旁盆栽提取图创建的独立簇生大叶植物；20 片舒展弯曲叶、绿色叶柄和暖色基部叶鞘、奶白粗陶圆盆。
design.reuse: Independent movable whole-plant asset for future placements on floors one, two and three; no room layouts changed.
design.species: Stylized reference interpretation; no botanical species assertion
design.geometry: Curved solid leaf blades with connected top/bottom/rims, arcing basal petioles, leaf sheaths, ceramic inner wall and rim, soil surface
design.materials: Embedded blade color/veins, ivory ceramic grain and soil color textures
design.undersideShading: Restrained green material fill retains readable undersides under the shared viewer lighting; blade geometry unchanged.

currentUsage.description: 主楼一层：4 号落地盆栽，共 1 处。独立形状，保留用于三款盆栽对比。

description: 公共母版：簇生大叶落地盆栽；当前 1 处引用。主楼一层：4 号落地盆栽，共 1 处。独立形状，保留用于三款盆栽对比。
